capabilities: Browse agent sessions in note-embedded dashboards or a dedicated view
Stream live OpenCode sessions and send prompts, stop runs, and answer approvals
Read Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Cursor transcripts read-only
Attach tagged markdown notes to sessions
Configure and start sessions via vibed code blocks
extras: Desktop-only (spawns sqlite3 and optional zstd and talks to local servers). Read-only connectors work from local history files with no server; live chat, prompts, and approvals require an OpenCode v2 server. The only writes outside the vault happen through snippet session config after explicit user consent; the plugin states it contains no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no way to view or interact with AI coding-agent session histories from inside the vault.

relations.evidence: OpenCode v2 remains the first-class citizen; everything else is a read-only companion.
